title: feat(scripts): provider retirement gate — block retiring a provider while config still references it (#5610)
body: Part of #5610 — implements item 1 of the fix-packet spec recorded on that issue (re-triage, task 12232): the provider retirement gate. ## What this adds - `scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh` — the retirement gate. Given a provider id, it greps the repo `.opencode/opencode.jsonc`, the deployed `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`, the `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.jsonc` copy, and the runtime-state config (or explicit `--config` files) and exits **1 (retirement BLOCKED)** while any active reference remains, **0** when zero references remain, **2** on usage/no-config errors (`--allow-empty` overrides the last). - `scripts/tests/test_check_provider_retirement_gate.py` — 7 contract tests (positive: references present → blocked; negative: no references → pass; explicit-config, missing-config, and usage cases). All 7 pass. - Wiring references so the gate is found at retirement time: a pointer block at the end of `.github/scripts/check-proxy-port-fallbacks.sh` and in the retirement note in `home/common/default.nix`. ## Verification (live, on the laptop, 2026-11-08) - `scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh opencode-route` → exit 1 (40 references in the deployed config and 40 in the repo config — retirement correctly blocked today). - `scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh no-such-provider-xyz` → exit 0. - Contract tests: 7/7 pass, before and after rebasing onto current `main`. ## Provenance / remaining scope on #5610 The gate commit was originally authored by lane code-k (commit ae96f39a44) in this task's worktree but never pushed or PR'd; this shift (task 13040, lane code-h) verified it, rebased it onto current main (b3be8d4c02), re-ran the tests, and opened this PR. Not in this PR, still tracked on #5610: the interim-state resolution is proceeding under #5768 (deploy-registry entry merged in PR #7631; activation waits on the systemd renderer slice and #7641), and the #3232 receipt-validation audit remains owed. This PR does not close #5610. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a provider retirement check that scans selected or discovered configuration files for active references. It ignores comments and disabled-provider entries, and can allow runs with no configuration files found. * **Documentation** * Added guidance to run the retirement check and verify that no active configuration references remain before retiring a provider. * **Tests** * Added coverage for matching and clean configurations, provider identity, comments, disabled entries, missing or unreadable files, and empty configuration sets.
